correctness.rationale: For a fixed compact nondegenerate convex polyhedron, decomposing the ordered surface-pair integral into pairs of planar facets yields an exactly local polynomial of degree at most four. The diagonal facet covariogram has area-loss coefficient -(2/3)perimeter(F) r^3 and each adjacent ordered facet pair contributes (2/3)L_e(pi-alpha_e)/sin(alpha_e) r^3 via a transverse wedge Jacobian; cross-pairs touching only at vertices are O(r^4), while disjoint pairs vanish near zero. Thus the CDF equals (pi/A)r^2+(4/(3A^2))sum_e L_e((pi-alpha_e)/sin(alpha_e)-1)r^3+C4(P)r^4 at 0<=r<r0(P), with all higher coefficients exactly absent. The inequality delta/sin(delta)>1+delta^2/6 on (0,pi), sharp as delta tends to zero, supplies the strict 2/(9A^2) squared-bend bound. Direct independent rational/numerical cube coefficient and small-bend checks agreed. Assumes maximal planar facets, ambient Euclidean rather than geodesic distance, and radius threshold depending on P; C4 is not explicitly computed.
